title: My Vulkan Modpack
description: A VulkanMod modpack that runs well.
body:
## My Vulkan Modpack

![Afternoon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/87b0cfa5302cc70114c3ad9cf168b479e435171e_0.webp)

My Vulkan Modpack is an optimized modpack made by myself to get **better FPS, stable gameplay and almost no lag spikes** in gameplay.

I did this modpack to save myself some time on downloading the mods back again, Just one click and its installed!

By default Beryl shaders are **off**, Turn it on on *Options > Graphics Settings > Beryl*


<details>
<summary>Screenshots</summary>

![Afternoon with Beryl Shaders ON](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/06e65694e65935ccb257ce81d9e622131fed6707_0.webp)
